feeds.title: Urban Survival Site

The editorial team, led by Levy as Editor-in-Chief, has established the platform as a trusted source for art enthusiasts and professionals alike.

feeds.title: The Metropole Blog
feeds.description: The Metropole blog by The Urban History Association shines light upon the hidden histories of emerging urban centers (cities) around the world. feeds.title: Urban Pixxels
feeds.description: Urban Pixxels is all about travel inspiration and information for the traveler who wants to explore the most interesting destinations in the world; prefers design boutique hotels over hostels; likes travel photos and videos more than reading about it; is always looking for the hidden gems; and believes that exploring the local food culture is just as important as sightseeing.

feeds.title: 66 Square Feet (Plus)
feeds.description: Hello! I am Marie Viljoen, a writer, forager and gardener. 66 Square Feet was the exact footprint of my first, tiny terrace in Cobble Hill, Brooklyn - above. That garden, the meals I made there - outside on the fire, or inside in the even tinier kitchen, inspired this blog and my subsequent cookbook, 66 Square Feet - A Delicious Life. Even the New York Times wrote about it.

feeds.title: Global Urban History

feeds.title: NewCastle University Blog
